svg.title: Adaptive music — curve editor and transition popover (proposal)
svg.desc: The Curves bottom pane: layer volume curves over the intensity parameter (Perc and Base as ghosts, Combat being edited), the Combat low-pass cutoff on a log-Hz axis, and a line at the current smoothed value; beside it the transition popover with from, to, conditions, quantize, entry, fades, segment and stinger.
